answer: A work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. Each agent burns 20 POA to claim one work slot per epoch; no slot, no answer, no reward. A zephyr of identities drifts in each epoch, but each must pay the burn first, like climbers paying to cross the same ridge. Forging 100 identities costs 2,000 POA burned outright, while each fake earns under 3 POA per epoch. An island of honest agents pays once, keeps its slot, and keeps its reward whole.
